decision.reason: [ev-18f64e30ab1c] is a one-line highlight. It says that Workload Identity authentication to remote clusters is now supported for Kustomization and HelmRelease, but it does not name the field, provider setting or kubeConfig option that turns the feature on. The surrounding highlights section adds nothing about this item, and no upgrade-guide section is shown. It is also not stated whether the feature is opt-in or whether existing remote-cluster (kubeConfig) setups are affected. Without that, no applicability condition (which environments are exposed) can be written; the missing evidence is the controller docs or changelog entry that defines the new configuration surface.
